Name: No Creepy Noises During Rain
Author: scoodii
Description:
I wanted to be able to enjoy the sound of the rain without feeling creeped out by whatever the unsettling noises that play are. This mod removes those noises and leaves only the sound of rain and thunder.

Not compatible with any other mod that replaces Wave Bank.xwb

[u]Installation:[/u][list=1]
[*]Make a backup of Wave Bank.xwb located in Stardew Valley\Content\XACT
[*]Place the Wave Bank.xwb file from this mod into Stardew Valley\Content\XACT and allow it to overwrite.
[*]Enjoy calming rain instead of creepy rain!
[/list]
Thanks to [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/old-post-in-new-thread-mod-list-modding-guides-and-general-modding-discussion.106868/page-7#post-2795638]Drogean[/url] and [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/sound-modding-tutorial-discussion-redux.127661/]joyous.ariella[/url] for the sound modding guides!
